concerns.text: The plan states that there is *no verified URL* for the global sea‑level pressure reanalysis dataset (NOAA NCEP/NCAR) in the provided list, yet the specification (`spec.md`) already includes a verified URL for this dataset (https://psl.noaa.gov/data/gridded/data.ncep.reanalysis.surface.html). This mischaracterization leads to unnecessary deferral of FR‑001 – FR‑014 and may cause the project to miss an opportunity to implement the full analysis pipeline within the current CI constraints. Update the plan to acknowledge the verified pressure dataset, incorporate it into Phase A or Phase B as appropriate, and adjust the data‑availability assessment accordingly.
